llm.summary: ThinkForce is a clearly scoped API guide for managing missions with a user-provided API key, with no hidden code or scanner findings.

dimensions.detail: The skill can create, update, run, schedule, share, invite collaborators to, and delete ThinkForce missions and subtasks, but those capabilities directly match its stated mission-orchestration purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to ThinkForce REST endpoints, require server-derived IDs, read-before-write behavior, budget/cost visibility, and explicit consent for destructive, sharing, and invite actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single SKILL.md file with no executable scripts, dependency installs, shell commands, or hidden installation behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It requires a ThinkForce API key and network access to app.thinkforce.ai; this is disclosed and proportionate for operating the user's ThinkForce workspace.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can create persistent schedules, webhook-triggered runs, share links, collaboration invites, and mission deletions, but these are documented and paired with user-control guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want your agent to operate your ThinkForce workspace with your API key. Review scheduled runs, webhooks, sharing, invites, deletions, and agent runs carefully because they can create ongoing work, costs, or external access.
